references.phrase: local Artinian rings B′ and B

references.context: Commutative algebra: surjective map of local rings respecting their unique maximal ideals
Ring theory: kernel of homomorphism as ideal of B′

references.phrase: I²=0 and maximal ideal annihilates I
references.disposition: These are mathematical consequences asserted of length-one kernel, not separate requirements equivalent for arbitrary extension.

review_rationale: Reviewed surjective local homomorphism B′→B, its kernel I of module length one, the square-zero consequence, and annihilation by the maximal ideal. A small extension is stronger than an arbitrary square-zero extension.
